# laravelforge_org_team_member (Resource)

Manages a user's membership and role within a Laravel Forge team. There is no create endpoint — a member joins a team through the invite flow (`laravelforge_org_team_invite`); this resource adopts an existing membership and manages its role (PUT) and removal (DELETE). It is commonly imported.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the user whose membership is managed.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `role_id` (Number) ID of the role assigned to the member within the team.
- `team_id` (Number) ID of the team the membership belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Membership creation timestamp.
- `email` (String) Member's email address.
- `name` (String) Member's name.
- `updated_at` (String) Membership update timestamp.
